note: The frozen instrument and rubric. Fixed before any respondent begins. A change after the first response opens a new cohort; it does not overwrite this one.

instrument.title: Interlock Video Cold Read — Take 1.0 (HAC-361)
instrument.publishBlockedUntil: the served bytes at the test URL reproduce the frozen sha256
instrument.derivedFrom: NakAGCaC — duplicated, not edited. The baseline instrument is unmodified.
instrument.aggregateScoreNote: No aggregate communication score is computed, stored or displayed. The seven criteria are reported separately and never summed.

gates.sceneContext: R01 PROBLEM (EVAL). N01 complete 0:01.0-5.5; N02 begins 0:07.1.
R01 -> R02 act boundary, PROBLEM to MECHANISM (29.000 / 28.600). Whole ordinary-locking demonstration seen; no mechanism yet.
R02 -> R03 act boundary, MECHANISM to COMPARISON (46.321 / 45.921). Four-strategy comparison NOT yet seen.
gates.deviation: 14 s earlier than the preregistered '~60 s'. Deliberate: the four-strategy comparison is what historically rescued comprehension in the UrofcPg8 page baseline, so observing before it tests whether the revision earns differentiation on its own.
gates.scoringRule: Asymmetric, fixed in advance. Demonstrated at 0:46 -> criterion 3 MET (46 < 60, met a fortiori). Not demonstrated at 0:46 -> recorded as 'NOT MET BY 0:46', NOT a failure of criterion 3; the full-artifact stage is then inspected and the outcome reported as 'met later, not by the gate'.

preservedUnchangedFromBaseline: unsupported_inferences — the 8-option truth-preservation control, all options identical
reader_background — still asked last so it cannot prime the cold read

criteria.name: Early problem comprehension
criteria.test: At 0:08, identifies the joint/concurrent interaction risk in plain language. Not 'AI agents', not 'locks', not 'three states'.
criteria.cohortThreshold: at least 2 of 3, or all readers if n=2

criteria.name: Relevance
criteria.test: Can say why the problem matters without needing the four-strategy comparison to discover the stakes.
criteria.cohortThreshold: the same readers who meet criterion 1

criteria.name: Differentiation
criteria.test: Explains what Interlock adds beyond ordinary locking or global serialization, in practical terms. Internal vocabulary is not required.
criteria.cohortThreshold: at least 2 of 3, or all readers if n=2

criteria.name: Attention
criteria.test: No majority reports working too hard before understanding the problem. Narration/subtitle density must not recreate the earlier pacing failure.

criteria.name: Investigation intent
criteria.test: Materially improves on the baseline 'No'. At minimum, no reader answers 'No' for lack of understanding of the core problem or value.

criteria.name: Truth preservation
criteria.test: Zero readers leave with a material unsupported inference from the prohibited list.
criteria.baselineCaveat: Already passing before the revision. A pass here is non-regression, NOT improvement, and may not be counted as evidence the revision worked.

criteria.name: Proof separation
criteria.test: Distinguishes the controlled evaluation from the Google Cloud participation demonstration by the end.

prohibitedInferences: The controlled evaluation itself ran in Google Cloud
Agent Runtime or Agent Gateway was part of the demonstrated path
The 403 / 401 / 403 controls prove the route is broadly secure
The animation speed represented real execution timing
Interlock is basically just another lock

mustInclude: at least one non-technical / non-coding reader
at least one technically literate reader with no involvement in Interlock
excluded: any model — an LLM read is not a receiver outcome and may never be recorded as one or used to fill a missing reader
prior reviewers who already know the narrative
anyone who saw the 2026-08-31 feedback or the positioning paragraph
the NakAGCaC baseline respondent — a second read would confound learning with revision
cohort.conduct: Readers must not discuss the film with each other until all have submitted.

dispositions.PASS: Materially better receiver comprehension and investigation intent, with claim/proof integrity preserved. Validates the receiver-validation METHOD only. Earns exactly one thing: a cross-domain receiver-validation experiment in Covenant Academy.
dispositions.NOT VALIDATED: No material improvement in receiver outcomes, improvement only in aesthetics/preference, or new confusion or unsupported inference. Stop. Do not rescue with infrastructure.
dispositions.MIXED — ITERATION WARRANTED: Early comprehension and relevance improve but one narrow, identifiable delivery problem remains. Any next iteration must name the single variable it changes.

earnedOnPass: a cross-domain receiver-validation experiment applying the receiver contract to Covenant Academy

confound.description: The pre/post spans two changes, not one: (a) narrative order — problem/relevance ahead of mechanism and brand; (b) delivery — spoken narration replacing a captions-only read. Both were human-derived, and HAC-361 criterion 4 contemplates narration. A PASS may NOT be attributed to ordering alone, and the disposition must say so.
